f: Partho is a poet, writer and teacher of Vedanta and Integral Yoga. He writes on Vedanta, spiritual Yoga and education. He is presently engaged in publishing the best of Indian spiritual and mystical literature in the English language. He takes Sri Aurobindo as his source of inspiration and guidance. Partho has authored a book on Integral Education (Integral Education: Beyond Schooling) and is currently working on his second work of fiction and a book on the Bhagavad Gita and Hindu Dharma.

b: Parul Dave Mukherji is a Professor at School of Arts and Aesthetics, Jawaharlal Nehru University, New Delhi, India. She has taught at the M. S. University, Baroda, and her books include InFlux: Contemporary Art in Asia…
f: Parul Dave Mukherji is a Professor at School of Arts and Aesthetics, Jawaharlal Nehru University, New Delhi, India. She has taught at the M. S. University, Baroda, and her books include InFlux: Contemporary Art in Asia (co-edited), Arts and Aesthetics in a Globalizing World , co-edited with Ramindar Kaur, and Ebrahim Alkazi Directing Art: The Making of a Modern Indian Art World (edited).

b: Parvati Sharma’s debut was a collection of short stories titled The Dead Camel and Other Stories of Love. She has also written the novel Close to Home , a historical biography titled Jahangir: An Intimate Portrait of…
f: Parvati Sharma’s debut was a collection of short stories titled The Dead Camel and Other Stories of Love. She has also written the novel Close to Home , a historical biography titled Jahangir: An Intimate Portrait of a Great Mughal and two books for children, The Story of Babur and Rattu & Poorie's Adventures in History: 1857. She writes a column on books and history for The Hindu BusinessLine and is working on her second work of narrative nonfiction.

b: Patricia A Lacina , a career member of the Senior Foreign Service, Class of Minister-Counselor, assumed the role of Chargé d’Affaires, for U.S. Mission to India in September 2021. From July 2018 until July 2021, she…
f: Patricia A Lacina , a career member of the Senior Foreign Service, Class of Minister-Counselor, assumed the role of Chargé d’Affaires, for U.S. Mission to India in September 2021. From July 2018 until July 2021, she served as Consul General at the U.S. Consulate in Frankfurt, Germany. From 2015 to 2017, she served as Principal Deputy Executive Secretary in the Office of the Secretary of State. From 2013 to 2015, she served as Deputy Chief Information Officer for Business, Management and Planning and Chief Knowledge Officer. Patricia’s overseas assignments include Management Officer in Cairo, Deputy Director of Frankfurt’s Regional Support Center, and Director of Human Resources in both Vienna and Brussels.

b: Patrick French is a historian and biographer and is currently writing the authorised biography of the novelist Doris Lessing. He is Dean of the School of Arts and Sciences and Professor for the Public Understanding of…
f: Patrick French is a historian and biographer and is currently writing the authorised biography of the novelist Doris Lessing. He is Dean of the School of Arts and Sciences and Professor for the Public Understanding of the Humanities at Ahmedabad University as well as a member of Emmanuel College Cambridge.

b: Patrick Radden Keefe , a staff writer at The New Yorker, is author of the upcoming book Empire of Pain: The Secret History of the Sackler Dynasty and the international bestseller Say Nothing , which received the…
f: Patrick Radden Keefe , a staff writer at The New Yorker, is author of the upcoming book Empire of Pain: The Secret History of the Sackler Dynasty and the international bestseller Say Nothing , which received the National Book Critics Circle Award and the Orwell Prize for Political Writing. He is also the creator of the podcast Wind of Change .

b: Paul Lynch is the prize-winning author of five novels: Prophet Song, Beyond the Sea , Grace , The Black Snow, and Red Sky in Morning . He was awarded The Booker Prize 2023 for his esteemed novel Prophet Song. He has won…
f: Paul Lynch is the prize-winning author of five novels: Prophet Song, Beyond the Sea , Grace , The Black Snow, and Red Sky in Morning . He was awarded The Booker Prize 2023 for his esteemed novel Prophet Song. He has won the Kerry Group Irish Novel of the Year and the French booksellers’ prize Prix Libr’Ã Nous for best foreign novel. He has also been shortlisted for UK’s Walter Scott Prize, the US’s William Saroyan International Prize, and France’s Prix Jean Monnet for European Literature and the Prix du Meilleur Livre Étranger, among other prizes. Libération has called Lynch “one of today’s greatest Irish writers”.

b: Paul McVeigh’s short stories have featured in anthologies, journals and newspapers, as well as, on BBC Radio 3, 4 & 5, and Sky Arts. He co-founded the London Short Story Festival and is associate director of Word…
f: Paul McVeigh’s short stories have featured in anthologies, journals and newspapers, as well as, on BBC Radio 3, 4 & 5, and Sky Arts. He co-founded the London Short Story Festival and is associate director of Word Factory, London, ‘the UK's national organisation for excellence in the short story’ (The Guardian) .

b: Paul Smith lives in Jaipur where he is writing two books, one on Shakespeare and Witness the other on the History of International Soft Power. He has lectured in literature at St Stephen’s College, University of Delhi,…
f: Paul Smith lives in Jaipur where he is writing two books, one on Shakespeare and Witness the other on the History of International Soft Power. He has lectured in literature at St Stephen’s College, University of Delhi, and then pursued doctoral studies in Renaissance Literature at Cambridge University. For forty years, from 1983 to 2023, he was an international director for the British Council with postings in Kano and Lagos (Nigeria), Burma, Chile, Bangladesh, New Zealand, India (Mumbai), Egypt, Afghanistan, USA (Washington DC), Indonesia and Germany. His London assignments were as the British Council’s Director Drama and Dance and as Global Director Arts. He has published numerous articles in academic texts.

b: Pavan K. Varma , a writer-diplomat, served in the Indian Foreign Service, holding positions such as Press Secretary to the President of India, Spokesman of the Ministry of External Affairs, High Commissioner for India…
f: Pavan K. Varma , a writer-diplomat, served in the Indian Foreign Service, holding positions such as Press Secretary to the President of India, Spokesman of the Ministry of External Affairs, High Commissioner for India in Cyprus, Director of the Nehru Centre in London, Director General of the Indian Council for Cultural Relations, New Delhi, and Ambassador of India to Bhutan. Varma was the National General Secretary of the JD(U) and subsequently, the National Vice-President of the All-India Trinamool Congress till 2022. Varma has written over a dozen best-selling books, including Krishna: The Playful Divine ; Ghalib: The Man, The Times ; and The Havelis of Old Delhi. His first book on a contemporary subject was the groundbreaking The Great Indian Middle Class, followed by Being Indian: The Truth About Why the 21st Century Will Be India’s . His first work of fiction, When Loss is Gain , is being adapted into a Bollywood film. His latest book is The Great Hindu Civilisation: Achievement, Neglect, Bias and the Way Forward . Varma’s Adi Shankaracharya: Hinduism’s Greatest Thinker received the Bengaluru Literature Festival prize for the Best Book of Non-Fiction in 2018, and he was honoured with an Honorary Doctorate for the same work by Sri Sharada Institute of Indian Management. He is also the recipient of the Kalinga International Literary Award 2019. He was awarded an Honorary Doctoral Degree by the University of Indianapolis in 2005 for his contributions to diplomacy, literature, culture, and aesthetics. He also received the Druk Thuksey Award, Bhutan's highest civilian honour, from His Majesty the King of Bhutan. He is the only serving Indian Ambassador in Bhutan to have received this prestigious award.

b: Pavithra Chari is a vocalist, lyricist, and composer, best known as one half of Shadow and Light , whose song Dua featured in the Grammy-nominated album Shuruaat . A disciple of Smt. Shubha Mudgal, she is a…
f: Pavithra Chari is a vocalist, lyricist, and composer, best known as one half of Shadow and Light , whose song Dua featured in the Grammy-nominated album Shuruaat . A disciple of Smt. Shubha Mudgal, she is a UNESCO-certified expressive arts therapist and a Forbes 30 Under 30 Asia fellow. As a playback singer, she has collaborated with AR Rahman, Sanjay Leela Bhansali, and Santhosh Narayanan.

b: Pawan Jain is the author of Kaivalyam: Jain Manuscript Paintings in the National Museum. Dr. Jain is an art historian, textile designer and serial entrepreneur, a visiting faculty at the National Museum Institute and…
f: Pawan Jain is the author of Kaivalyam: Jain Manuscript Paintings in the National Museum. Dr. Jain is an art historian, textile designer and serial entrepreneur, a visiting faculty at the National Museum Institute and has taught at NIFT. She specialises in Jain art and the study of textiles and sartorial styles in Jain manuscript paintings, and has published several art history research papers in various journals and bulletins. She is the co-founder of two successful textile printing and handloom ventures.

b: Payal Arora is a digital anthropologist, a TEDx speaker and an award-winning author of several books, including The Next Billion Users with Harvard Press. Her expertise lies in ethical AI, inclusive design and global…
f: Payal Arora is a digital anthropologist, a TEDx speaker and an award-winning author of several books, including The Next Billion Users with Harvard Press. Her expertise lies in ethical AI, inclusive design and global digital cultures. Forbes named her the ‘next billion champion’ and the right kind of person to reform tech. She is a Professor at Erasmus University and is based in Amsterdam.

b: Payal Puri is a writer, editor, and co-founder of Qomix, a creative enterprise based in Singapore and India that uses the graphic form to make complex storytelling compelling for new generations. Previously, she…
f: Payal Puri is a writer, editor, and co-founder of Qomix, a creative enterprise based in Singapore and India that uses the graphic form to make complex storytelling compelling for new generations. Previously, she co-founded Algebra: The Arts & Ideas Club, hosting critical interdisciplinary conversations across four cities, and co-founded the critically acclaimed podcast Mutant: Dialogues at the End of Democracy .

b: Peeyush Ranjan , Vice President of Engineering at Google, has played a key role in shaping technologies like Google Pay, Moto G, OK Google, and Gemini. Formerly CTO at Flipkart and VP at Airbnb, he holds computer…
f: Peeyush Ranjan , Vice President of Engineering at Google, has played a key role in shaping technologies like Google Pay, Moto G, OK Google, and Gemini. Formerly CTO at Flipkart and VP at Airbnb, he holds computer science degrees from IIT Kharagpur and Purdue, along with an MBA from the University of Washington.

b: Pepa Roma is a Spanish journalist and novelist whose bond with India began in 1972 during a two-year, round-the-world journey. The author of eight books, she explores a generation’s spiritual quest in Mandala (Andalucía…
f: Pepa Roma is a Spanish journalist and novelist whose bond with India began in 1972 during a two-year, round-the-world journey. The author of eight books, she explores a generation’s spiritual quest in Mandala (Andalucía Prize) and Indian Express (Azorín Prize). As a correspondent for major Spanish media outlets, she has covered key world events.

b: Per J. Andersson is a Swedish writer and journalist. He is the co-founder and editor of Vagabond , Sweden’s leading travel magazine. He came to India the first time back in 1983 on a 6 month trip as a backpacker and…
f: Per J. Andersson is a Swedish writer and journalist. He is the co-founder and editor of Vagabond , Sweden’s leading travel magazine. He came to India the first time back in 1983 on a 6 month trip as a backpacker and has since returned once or twice a year to report about everything from food and travel to social issues, literature and politics. Between 2007 and 2009, he was a freelance correspondent in India for the Swedish news agency TT. He has written several books about India, including Modern India and The Elephant Who Began to Dance . His latest book, partly set in India, is the nonfiction work, The Amazing Story of the Man Who Cycled from India to Europe for Love . It was published in Swedish in 2013 and in English in 2017. It has been translated into 15 languages worldwide, including Mandarin, Vietnamese, Thai, Korean and Russian. His latest book, For Those Who Travel the World is Beautiful , is about the art of travel and ask questions about why we travel and how it affects our perception of the world.

b: Pernia Qureshi is an Indian American fashion entrepreneur and classical dancer based in New Delhi and Mumbai. Trained as a Kuchipudi dancer, she has performed across India and worldwide. Pernia has worked as a stylist…
f: Pernia Qureshi is an Indian American fashion entrepreneur and classical dancer based in New Delhi and Mumbai. Trained as a Kuchipudi dancer, she has performed across India and worldwide. Pernia has worked as a stylist for Harper's Bazaar, Elle, CondeNast and designed costumes for the Bollywood film, Aisha . In 2012, Pernia's entrepreneurial journey began when she founded Pernia's Pop Up Shop, India's first e-commerce platform selling Indian designer wear to a global clientele. Pernia’s 2013 book Be Stylish is a fashion guide for South Asian women. Recently, Pernia has published a book called Ammi’s Kitchen with grandmother’s heirloom recipes with the best dishes Rampur has to offer.

b: Perumal Murugan works as a Head and Associate Professor of Tamil Literature at government arts college in Tamil Nadu. He is the author of 11 novels and five collections each of short stories and poems, as well as ten…
f: Perumal Murugan works as a Head and Associate Professor of Tamil Literature at government arts college in Tamil Nadu. He is the author of 11 novels and five collections each of short stories and poems, as well as ten books of nonfiction. Several of his novels, stories and poems have been translated into English, including Seasons of the Palm , which was shortlisted for the Kiriyama prize, Current Show, One Part woman and Pyre. His best-known novel One Part Woman won the prestigious ILF Samanvay Bhasha Samman for Writing in Indian languages. His recent novel Poonachi has been shortlisted for several awards including JCB award. His latest book is Amma.

b: Peter Bergen is a vice president at New America, CNN national security analyst, a professor at Arizona State University, the author of five books, three of which were New York Times bestsellers. They have been…
f: Peter Bergen is a vice president at New America, CNN national security analyst, a professor at Arizona State University, the author of five books, three of which were New York Times bestsellers. They have been translated into 21 languages. He has held teaching positions at Harvard and Johns Hopkins.

b: Peter Bos is a professional portrait photographer from The Netherlands. He travels to the corners of the world, capturing the essence of unique cultures and people through intimate portraits. His work method is…
f: Peter Bos is a professional portrait photographer from The Netherlands. He travels to the corners of the world, capturing the essence of unique cultures and people through intimate portraits. His work method is distinctive; he submerges into the local society and establishes good relationships with a personal approach.

b: Peter Coveney is a Fellow of the Royal Academy of Engineering, Member of Academia Europaea, Professor of Physical Chemistry and Director of the Centre for Computational Science at University College London. He has…
f: Peter Coveney is a Fellow of the Royal Academy of Engineering, Member of Academia Europaea, Professor of Physical Chemistry and Director of the Centre for Computational Science at University College London. He has published three books for the general reader, The Arrow of Time , Frontiers of Complexity and Virtual You .

b: Peter Frankopan is Professor of Global History at Oxford University. His books include The Silk Roads: A New History of the World; The New Silk Roads: The Present and Future of the World; and The Earth Transformed: an…
f: Peter Frankopan is Professor of Global History at Oxford University. His books include The Silk Roads: A New History of the World; The New Silk Roads: The Present and Future of the World; and The Earth Transformed: an Untold History. Often described as a ‘rockstar’ academic (BBC, New Statesman, VLT, Der Spiegel, he has been called ‘the first great historian of the 21st century’ by Brazil’s DCM magazine.

b: Peter Godwin is the author of six non-fiction books including Mukiwa , which received the George Orwell Prize, and When a Crocodile Eats the Sun , which won the Borders Original Voices Award. His book, The Fear, was…
f: Peter Godwin is the author of six non-fiction books including Mukiwa , which received the George Orwell Prize, and When a Crocodile Eats the Sun , which won the Borders Original Voices Award. His book, The Fear, was selected by the New Yorker as the best book of the year. His latest book is Exit Wounds: A Story of Love, Loss, and Occasional Wars. He has taught writing at Wesleyan and Columbia, and served as President of the PEN American Center.

b: Peter Hessler has been a staff writer at The New Yorker for the past 20 years, where he has focused mostly on China and Egypt. He has been awarded a MacArthur fellowship, a National Magazine Award and was a finalist for…
f: Peter Hessler has been a staff writer at The New Yorker for the past 20 years, where he has focused mostly on China and Egypt. He has been awarded a MacArthur fellowship, a National Magazine Award and was a finalist for the National Book Award. His fifth book, The Buried , was published last year.

b: Peter Meech is an author, screenwriter, director and producer. His memoir, Mysteries of the Life Force: My Apprenticeship with a Chi Kung Master , has been translated into several languages. He has an MA in…
f: Peter Meech is an author, screenwriter, director and producer. His memoir, Mysteries of the Life Force: My Apprenticeship with a Chi Kung Master , has been translated into several languages. He has an MA in Communications from Stanford, where he won a Stanford Nicholl writing award. His debut novel is Billy (the Kid).

b: Peter Moore is the Sunday Times bestselling author of The Weather Experiment and Endeavour. He teaches creative writing at the University of Oxford. His latest book, Life, Liberty and the pursuit of Happiness: Britain…
f: Peter Moore is the Sunday Times bestselling author of The Weather Experiment and Endeavour. He teaches creative writing at the University of Oxford. His latest book, Life, Liberty and the pursuit of Happiness: Britain and the American Dream, was published in 2023.

b: Peter Sarris is Professor of Late Antique, Medieval, and Byzantine Studies at the University of Cambridge. Of British and Cypriot descent, he studied History at Balliol College, Oxford, and was also a Prize Fellow of…
f: Peter Sarris is Professor of Late Antique, Medieval, and Byzantine Studies at the University of Cambridge. Of British and Cypriot descent, he studied History at Balliol College, Oxford, and was also a Prize Fellow of All Souls College, Oxford. His latest book: Justinian: Emperor, Soldier, Saint was awarded the London Hellenic Prize for the best book published in English relating to Greek history or culture. He splits his time between Cambridge and Thessaloniki.

b: Peter Stamm has published nine novels, five collections of short stories, several children's books, radio, and stage plays. His books have been translated into 41 languages.
f: Peter Stamm has published nine novels, five collections of short stories, several children's books, radio, and stage plays. His books have been translated into 41 languages.

b: Peter Stewart is a Professor of Ancient Art and the Director of the Classical Art Research Centre at Oxford University. He is the author of numerous publications about Graeco-Roman and Gandharan sculpture. He is…
f: Peter Stewart is a Professor of Ancient Art and the Director of the Classical Art Research Centre at Oxford University. He is the author of numerous publications about Graeco-Roman and Gandharan sculpture. He is currently working on a new book about the relationship between Roman imperial art and the wider ancient world.

b: Phejin Konyak is the great granddaughter of a tattooed head-hunter, Ahon, who was a prominent member of the Konyak tribe. He was one of the first interpreters to travel with the British ethnographer JH Hutton during his…
f: Phejin Konyak is the great granddaughter of a tattooed head-hunter, Ahon, who was a prominent member of the Konyak tribe. He was one of the first interpreters to travel with the British ethnographer JH Hutton during his writing of the Diaries of Two Tours in the Naga Hills in 1923. Phejin lives in Shiyong village, Mon District, Nagaland, India. In between running the Konyak Tea Retreat and her farm, she writes and travels to remote villages interacting with the tattooed elders and documenting the tattoo patterns, poems and sayings.

b: Pheroza J Godrej , Chairperson of the Godrej Archives Council and Advisor, Godrej Mangroves, is an art-historian and holds a Ph.D. in Ancient Indian Culture. She founded the Cymroza Art Gallery and authored various…
f: Pheroza J Godrej , Chairperson of the Godrej Archives Council and Advisor, Godrej Mangroves, is an art-historian and holds a Ph.D. in Ancient Indian Culture. She founded the Cymroza Art Gallery and authored various publications and curated highly acclaimed exhibitions for leading national and international museums. She is Chairperson of the Museum Society of Mumbai and on the Executive Boards of the Ashoka Trust for Research in Ecology (ATREE), and the Oxford India Centre for Sustainable Development International Advisory Council. She is an ardent promoter of the Cornelia Sorabji Programme, and supports the Cornelia Sorabji Scholarship at Somerville College, Oxford. She is a Member of the Advisory Council for the JCB Prize for Literature, and a fellow of the Royal Society for the encouragement of Arts, Manufacturers & Commerce (RSA).

b: Philip A. Lutgendorf is Professor of Hindi and Modern Indian Studies at the University of Iowa. Much of his research has focused on the Ramayana tradition in North India. He is the author of The Life of a Text:…
f: Philip A. Lutgendorf is Professor of Hindi and Modern Indian Studies at the University of Iowa. Much of his research has focused on the Ramayana tradition in North India. He is the author of The Life of a Text: Performing the Rāmcaritmānas of Tulsidas and of Hanuman’s Tale, The Messages of a Divine Monkey . His interests include epic performance traditions, folklore and popular culture, and he maintains a website devoted to Bollywood cinema ( http://www.uiowa.edu/indiancinema/ ). Current projects include a book on the cultural history of chai and a new translation of the Ramcharitmanas of Tulsidas , in seven dual-language volumes, for the Murty Classical Library of India ( http://www.murtylibrary.com/volumes.php ). He has served, since 2010, as President of the American Institute of Indian Studies ( http://www.indiastudies.org )

b: High Commissioner Philip Green is an Australian diplomat with experience on four continents - Ambassador or High Commissioner to Germany, Singapore, South Africa and Kenya. He also served as head of the division in the…
f: High Commissioner Philip Green is an Australian diplomat with experience on four continents - Ambassador or High Commissioner to Germany, Singapore, South Africa and Kenya. He also served as head of the division in the Department of Foreign Affairs and Trade responsible for managing Australia’s relations with the United States during the Trump Presidency. His career includes many highlights such as the Lead responsibility for the development of Australia’s policy on the Quad from 2017 to 2019; Piloting the conclusion of the Enhanced Strategic Partnership with Germany and the Australia-Germany Hydrogen Accord (2021); the conclusion of Australia’s Comprehensive Strategic Partnership with Singapore in 2016, and upgrade to the Australia-Singapore Free Trade Agreement. Mr Green was also Prime Minister Kevin Rudd’s International Adviser between 2009 and 2010.

b: Philip Marsden is an award-winning author whose works encompass travel, history, and ecology, translated into fifteen languages. He resides in Cornwall, UK, where he is restoring marine and terrestrial habitats on his…
f: Philip Marsden is an award-winning author whose works encompass travel, history, and ecology, translated into fifteen languages. He resides in Cornwall, UK, where he is restoring marine and terrestrial habitats on his small piece of land.

b: Philip Norman is an internationally renowned chronicler of pop music and culture. Shout! , his definitive biography of the Beatles, first published in 1981, has remained continuously in print, selling more than one…
f: Philip Norman is an internationally renowned chronicler of pop music and culture. Shout! , his definitive biography of the Beatles, first published in 1981, has remained continuously in print, selling more than one million copies. He has since written similar worldwide bestsellers about the Rolling Stones, Elton John, Buddy Holly John Lennon, Mick Jagger and, most recently, Sir Paul McCartney. An award-winning writer of fiction, he is also the author of two stage musicals, This is Elvis: Viva Las Vegas and Laughter in the Rain: the Neil Sedaka Story .

b: Philip Pullman was born in Norwich and brought up mainly in north Wales. He studied English at Oxford and then worked as a schoolteacher and lecturer for 12 years before writing full-time. His best-known work is the…
f: Philip Pullman was born in Norwich and brought up mainly in north Wales. He studied English at Oxford and then worked as a schoolteacher and lecturer for 12 years before writing full-time. His best-known work is the trilogy His Dark Materials ’ recently adapted for TV by BBC and HBO.

b: Philipp Ackermann studied art history and economics in Bonn, Heidelberg and Utrecht, and received his doctorate in art history in 1993. That same year he joined the German Foreign Service. In his career, he has headed…
f: Philipp Ackermann studied art history and economics in Bonn, Heidelberg and Utrecht, and received his doctorate in art history in 1993. That same year he joined the German Foreign Service. In his career, he has headed the German Provincial Reconstruction Team in Kunduz, Afghanistan and served as political counsellor in New Delhi. He has also been the Deputy Head of Mission in Washington DC. From 2010 to 2014, he held the position as Head of Task Force Afghanistan-Pakistan in the Federal Foreign Office and as Deputy Special Representative for Afghanistan and Pakistan. Before being assigned to his current job, he was Director General for Africa, Latin America, Near and Middle East at the Federal Foreign Office for five years.

b: Philippe Sands is Professor of Law at University College London, and a Visiting Professor of Law at Harvard. He is a practising barrister at 11KBW, appears as counsel before the International Court of Justice and other…
f: Philippe Sands is Professor of Law at University College London, and a Visiting Professor of Law at Harvard. He is a practising barrister at 11KBW, appears as counsel before the International Court of Justice and other international courts and tribunals, and sits as an international arbitrator. He is a regular contributor and commentator on international law and justice in several publications, including the Guardian, Financial Times, and New York Times, and appears regularly on the BBC and CNN. His latest books are East West Street: On the Origins of Crimes Against Humanity and Genocide (2016), The Ratline: Love, Lies and Justice on the Trail of a Nazi Fugitive (2020) and The Last Colony: A Tale of Exile, Justice and Britain’s Colonial Legacy (2022).

b: Pia Brancaccio is Professor of Art History at Drexel University in Philadelphia, USA. Her research focuses on early Buddhist art in South Asia and cross-cultural exchange, with a special focus on the ancient regions of…
f: Pia Brancaccio is Professor of Art History at Drexel University in Philadelphia, USA. Her research focuses on early Buddhist art in South Asia and cross-cultural exchange, with a special focus on the ancient regions of Gandhara and the Western Deccan. She has published on the Buddhist caves at Aurangabad, cave temples in Maharashtra, and Gandharan art.

b: Pico Iyer is the author of two novels and ten works of nonfiction, most recently T he Man Within My Head and The Art of Stillness . His books have been translated into 23 languages and his TED Talks have received more…
f: Pico Iyer is the author of two novels and ten works of nonfiction, most recently T he Man Within My Head and The Art of Stillness . His books have been translated into 23 languages and his TED Talks have received more than 7 million views.

b: Piero Boitani is Professor Emeritus of Comparative Literature at the University of Rome ‘Sapienza’ and at the University of Italian Switzerland, Lugano. A Fellow of, amongst others, the British Academy, the Medieval…
f: Piero Boitani is Professor Emeritus of Comparative Literature at the University of Rome ‘Sapienza’ and at the University of Italian Switzerland, Lugano. A Fellow of, amongst others, the British Academy, the Medieval Academy of America, and the Accademia dei Lincei, in 2016 he received the Balzan Prize for Comparative Literature. His most recent books in English include Looking Upwards: Stars in Ancient and Medieval Cultures, The Machine of the World: the Modern Cosmos, A New Sublime and Ten Timeless Lessons on the Classics.

b: Pilar Maria Guerrieri is a historian of architecture. She is Adjunct Professor of History and Theory of Contemporary Architecture in Politecnico di Milano in Milan and at GD Goenka University in Delhi. She has been…
f: Pilar Maria Guerrieri is a historian of architecture. She is Adjunct Professor of History and Theory of Contemporary Architecture in Politecnico di Milano in Milan and at GD Goenka University in Delhi. She has been extensively studying the city of Delhi and is the author of Maps of Delhi and Negotiating Cultures: Delhi’s Architecture and Planning from 1912 to 1962 .

b: Pinak Ranjan Chakravarty served twice in Bangladesh, first as Deputy High Commissioner and later as High Commissioner to Bangladesh. He also served as Ambassador to Thailand and Secretary in the Ministry of External…
f: Pinak Ranjan Chakravarty served twice in Bangladesh, first as Deputy High Commissioner and later as High Commissioner to Bangladesh. He also served as Ambassador to Thailand and Secretary in the Ministry of External Affairs and has held diplomatic positions in Egypt, Saudi Arabia, the UK, Pakistan, Israel and Bangladesh. Chakravarty is a visiting fellow at the Observer Research Foundation and Founder Director of DeepStrat, a new think tank.

b: Pinaki Misra was educated at St. Stephen’s College and Faculty of Law, Delhi University. He has practiced as a Senior Advocate in the Supreme Court of India and has a specialisation in Corporate Law, Foreign Exchange,…
f: Pinaki Misra was educated at St. Stephen’s College and Faculty of Law, Delhi University. He has practiced as a Senior Advocate in the Supreme Court of India and has a specialisation in Corporate Law, Foreign Exchange, Customs and Excise Laws, Mining related Laws, Company Laws, Environmental Laws and Constitutional Laws. In 1996, he was elected to the 11th Lok Sabha and re-elected for subsequent terms in 2009, 2014 and 2019. He has served as a Member of the Standing Committees on External Affairs, Civil Aviation, Personnel, Public Grievances, Law and Justice, Finance and as Chairperson of the Standing Committee on Urban Development. From October 2019, he has served as leader of the Biju Janata Dal Legislature Party in the Lok Sabha

b: Pinky Anand , a trustee of The Arts and Cultural Heritage Trust is a designated Senior Advocate and is the former Additional Solicitor General of India. A Doctorate of Law, graduate of the Harvard Law School and an…
f: Pinky Anand , a trustee of The Arts and Cultural Heritage Trust is a designated Senior Advocate and is the former Additional Solicitor General of India. A Doctorate of Law, graduate of the Harvard Law School and an Inlaks scholar, Honorary Professor at Amity Law School, she is the second woman in India to have been awarded this high Constitutional Law office. She is the Vice President of Bar Association of India and Alternate Country Councillor (India) LAWASIA and Chair ADR committee (Business Law Section, Lawasia and Governing Body Member of Indian Council of Arbitration. A versatile multifaceted person, social activist, a leading lawyer in diverse fields, her accomplishments extend from legal expertise to media to politics to social activities. She has worked tirelessly for the cause of social development and has achieved numerous milestones in her endeavour be it for the development of the country, right of free speech, eradication of malpractices or the protection of children. The causes espoused by her have led us towards milestone changes in the legal fabric. She has been honoured with several awards for excellence in law and has led India in several international forums including BRICS Legal Forum in Brazil, China, South Africa and Shanghai Co-operation Organization Prosecutors’ General Meeting in Russia, Tajikistan. Trustee of the Partition Museum, she has authored books including Trials of Truth by Penguin. A prestigious alumni of Campus Law Centre, Delhi University, she excelled in academics and also led the student community as the first woman Secretary of DUSU. She has a distinguished career and been acclaimed with number of national and international awards.

b: Piyush Kumar heads the Prabhat Group (incorporating Prabhat Prakashan, Ocean Books (P) Ltd. and Prabhat Paperbacks). Prabhat Prakashan Pvt. Ltd. is one of the leading publishing houses of India, which till date, has…
f: Piyush Kumar heads the Prabhat Group (incorporating Prabhat Prakashan, Ocean Books (P) Ltd. and Prabhat Paperbacks). Prabhat Prakashan Pvt. Ltd. is one of the leading publishing houses of India, which till date, has published over 6,000 titles of quality books on almost all streams of literature. Their illustrious authors include the Hon’ble Prime Minister of India Shri Narendra Modi, former Secretary of State Hillary Clinton, former Presidents of India, Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam, Dr. Shankar Dayal Sharma, Nobel Laureate Sir V.S. Naipaul.

b: Piyush Pandey is chairman of Global Creative and executive chairman of Ogilvy India. He was awarded the Lifetime Achievement Award by the Advertising Agencies Association of India, Clio Lifetime Achievement Award, Padma…
f: Piyush Pandey is chairman of Global Creative and executive chairman of Ogilvy India. He was awarded the Lifetime Achievement Award by the Advertising Agencies Association of India, Clio Lifetime Achievement Award, Padma Shri and the Lion of St Mark, along with his brother Prasoon Pandey, at Cannes. His first book, Pandeymonium , is on his life and times in advertising. Ogilvy India has been India's No. 1 creative agency for over two decades, and Pandey has been named the Economic Times' Most Influential Person fourteen years in a row. Ogilvy was the first advertising job that he got and that's where he continues to be.

b: Poonam Muttreja, Executive Director of the Population Foundation of India, is a renowned advocate for women’s rights, health, reproductive and sexual rights, and rural livelihoods for over 40 years. She co-conceived the…
f: Poonam Muttreja, Executive Director of the Population Foundation of India, is a renowned advocate for women’s rights, health, reproductive and sexual rights, and rural livelihoods for over 40 years. She co-conceived the transmedia initiative Main Kuch Bhi Kar Sakti Hoon . Previously, she served as India Country Director of the MacArthur Foundation for 15 years and co-founded Ashoka (India), Dastkar, and SRUTI. An alumna of Delhi University and Harvard Kennedy School, she serves on multiple boards, including ActionAid and The National Academies of Sciences, and is a frequent commentator in Indian and global media on development, policy, and social issues.

b: Poonam Saxena is a journalist, writer, and translator with a distinguished career at The Hindustan Times , where she launched and edited the HT Sunday magazine, Brunch , for over ten years before editing the weekend…
f: Poonam Saxena is a journalist, writer, and translator with a distinguished career at The Hindustan Times , where she launched and edited the HT Sunday magazine, Brunch , for over ten years before editing the weekend section. She writes a regular column exploring India’s past through Hindi literature and cinema and has written extensively on popular culture, film, television, books, and Hindi literature. A prolific translator from Hindi to English, her works include Gunahon ka Devta , Scene: 75 , The Greatest Hindi Stories Ever Told , Qayaas , and memoirs of Mannu Bhandari and Rajendra Yadav. She also co-authored filmmaker Karan Johar’s memoir, An Unsuitable Boy .

b: Poonam Surie transverses academia, poetry and journalism. The last four decades living across many continents, observing different cultures and ethnicities forms the basis of her writing across genres and provides…
f: Poonam Surie transverses academia, poetry and journalism. The last four decades living across many continents, observing different cultures and ethnicities forms the basis of her writing across genres and provides diverse content, perspective and versatility to her work. She also creates evocative poetry. As an author, she has written about the philosophical underpinnings of old civilisations, governance and contemporary Chinese society.

b: In the 21 years that she has been in publishing, Poulomi Chatterjee has worked at Macmillan India Ltd; Penguin Books India, where in addition to her editorial responsibilities she managed the rights and contracts…
f: In the 21 years that she has been in publishing, Poulomi Chatterjee has worked at Macmillan India Ltd; Penguin Books India, where in addition to her editorial responsibilities she managed the rights and contracts departments; and Hachette India, where she is presently Editor-in-Chief and Publisher of the adult and business books division. In the course of her career, she has acquired and edited the works of a variety of authors across genres, and has enjoyed working with some of the most talented and prominent Indian writers writing in English.

b: Poulomi Chatterjee Bose is an actor, theatre director, dancer, choreographer and Artistic director of her group Mukhomukhi. She started her acting career under Utpal Dutt and has performed in several acclaimed plays…
f: Poulomi Chatterjee Bose is an actor, theatre director, dancer, choreographer and Artistic director of her group Mukhomukhi. She started her acting career under Utpal Dutt and has performed in several acclaimed plays under the direction of her illustrious father, the late Soumitra Chatterjee. Poulami has choreographed, directed and performed in many acclaimed theatre and dance productions. Apart from theatre, she has performed in many audio plays and been a voice-over artist for many documentaries and television programmes. She learnt dance from Amala Shankar and specialised in Bharatnatyam under Kalamandalam Thankamani Kutty. She has performed all over India and abroad and runs her own dance institute, Aanarto. Poulami has been a member of the Paschim Banga Natya Academy and has been recently awarded the Rama Prasad Banik Puroshkar.

b: Prabhat Ranjan is a fiction writer, translator, and editor best known for Kothagoi , the first Hindi book on the history of the tawaif tradition. The work earned him the Dwarika Prasad Agrawal Bhaskar Yuva Puraskar at…
f: Prabhat Ranjan is a fiction writer, translator, and editor best known for Kothagoi , the first Hindi book on the history of the tawaif tradition. The work earned him the Dwarika Prasad Agrawal Bhaskar Yuva Puraskar at the Jaipur Literature Festival in 2016. His recent novel Kissagram has received wide acclaim and won the Kalinga Book Award in 2024, with its English translation forthcoming. Ranjan also won the Kalinga Translation Award in 2023 for translating Jerry Pinto’s Murder in Mahim . He is the moderator of the renowned literary and cultural website Jankipul.com .

b: Pradeep Mehta is an exceptional and passionate public policy advocate having achieved many critical policy changes in India and elsewhere, following his motto to make the world a better place to live in. Noted…
f: Pradeep Mehta is an exceptional and passionate public policy advocate having achieved many critical policy changes in India and elsewhere, following his motto to make the world a better place to live in. Noted economist, Prof Jagdish Bhagwati calls him a ‘living treasure’ and ‘God’s gift to India’.

b: Pradip Krishen is a filmmaker who became an ‘ecological gardener’, and began restoring degraded habitats with native plants in 2002. He created Rao Jodha Desert Rock Park in Jodhpur, Kishan Baghin northern Jaipur…
f: Pradip Krishen is a filmmaker who became an ‘ecological gardener’, and began restoring degraded habitats with native plants in 2002. He created Rao Jodha Desert Rock Park in Jodhpur, Kishan Baghin northern Jaipur city and curated the Calico Museum garden (Ahmedabad) and Abha Mahal Bagh in Nagaur. He is the author of The Trees of Delhi and The Jungle Trees of Central India.

b: Pragya Sharma is a graduate in Economics (Hns.), with a Master’s in Business Administration from S.P. Jain Institute of Management & Research Mumbai, and a work experience of 17 years. She has worked with Unilever for…
f: Pragya Sharma is a graduate in Economics (Hns.), with a Master’s in Business Administration from S.P. Jain Institute of Management & Research Mumbai, and a work experience of 17 years. She has worked with Unilever for 16 years on diverse sales, marketing and business roles in India and MENA region (Middle East and North Africa), across the categories of Beauty & Personal Care, Coffee and Tea. She joined Amazon India in October 2020 as the Director for Media category which includes books, video games, software, toys and personal care appliances. Her curiosity and passion for learning drive her. She is formally trained in performing arts and is a certified theatre improviser as well.

b: Pragya Tiwari is a writer and journalist. She has led publications such as Vice and Tehelka, founded publications such as The Indian History Collective and The Big Indian Picture , and written on policy, politics and…
f: Pragya Tiwari is a writer and journalist. She has led publications such as Vice and Tehelka, founded publications such as The Indian History Collective and The Big Indian Picture , and written on policy, politics and culture across national and international publications. She currently runs Oijo, a culture and communications consultancy, co-hosts The India Briefing podcast and is working on a book on nationalism and modernity.

b: Prahlad Kakar started his career in advertising in the early ’70s in ASP Delhi. He then moved on to gain experience in feature films with his mentor and leading filmmaker, Shyam Benegal. After assisting him on…
f: Prahlad Kakar started his career in advertising in the early ’70s in ASP Delhi. He then moved on to gain experience in feature films with his mentor and leading filmmaker, Shyam Benegal. After assisting him on renowned features like 'Ankur', 'Nishant', 'Manthan' and 'Bhumika', Kakar moved on to become an independent film director in the field of Advertising. He is the Founder and Director of Genesis Film Production Pvt. Ltd., one of the leading production houses in India. With his brand of irreverent humour, memorable brand building campaigns, Kakar has created award-winning commercials for the most reputed Corporates and agencies in India and the Asia Pacific region for over four decades.

b: Prahlad Singh is Director at the Alternative Development & Research Centre and the author of eight books, including Human Development, Well-being and Globalisation , Aspects of Human Development and Culture and…
f: Prahlad Singh is Director at the Alternative Development & Research Centre and the author of eight books, including Human Development, Well-being and Globalisation , Aspects of Human Development and Culture and Literature and Freedom . He has also written for the Hindustan Times , the Times of India , Indian Express and The Hindu as well as foreign publications such as Resurgence, Policy Innovations and Seeds of Peace .

b: Prajakta Koli is a leading digital creator, actor, and activist with over 17 million followers. Known for her roles in Mismatched and Jug Jugg Jeeyo , she will release her debut novel, Too Good To Be True , in 2025.…
f: Prajakta Koli is a leading digital creator, actor, and activist with over 17 million followers. Known for her roles in Mismatched and Jug Jugg Jeeyo , she will release her debut novel, Too Good To Be True , in 2025. Prajakta is the UNDP's first Indian Youth Climate Champion and serves on the Gates Foundation's Goalkeepers advisory group. A voice for climate action and girls' education, she has featured in Michelle Obama’s Emmy-winning docuseries.

b: Prajwal Parajuly is the author of The Gurkha’s Daughter: Stories and the novel Land Where I Flee . His works have been recognized internationally, with nominations for the Dylan Thomas Prize and the Mogford Prize (UK),…
f: Prajwal Parajuly is the author of The Gurkha’s Daughter: Stories and the novel Land Where I Flee . His works have been recognized internationally, with nominations for the Dylan Thomas Prize and the Mogford Prize (UK), the Emile Guimet Prize and the First Novel Prize (France), and The Story Prize (US). Land Where I Flee won the Prix Littéraire Chambre de Commerce et d'Industrie Franco-Indienne 2024. Prajwal teaches fiction at Krea University in South India and splits his time between New York and Sri City. His forthcoming children’s book, Karma and Lola , will be published by Tate Books in late 2026.

b: Prakash Dan Detha is a cultural documentarian and organic farming advocate from Borunda village, Jodhpur, Rajasthan. With a master’s degree from Rajasthan University, Jaipur, he transformed his family farm into an…
f: Prakash Dan Detha is a cultural documentarian and organic farming advocate from Borunda village, Jodhpur, Rajasthan. With a master’s degree from Rajasthan University, Jaipur, he transformed his family farm into an organic enterprise. Trained in documentary filmmaking at BBC London, he collaborated with luminaries like late Shri Komal Kothari and late Shri Vijay Dan Detha on films about Rajasthani culture. He has worked with filmmakers Mira Nair and Bernardo Bertolucci, designed and exported clothing to Europe, and led educational tours for Roadscholar USA for two decades.

b: Pramod Bhasin is Chairman of ICRIER and the Data Security Council of India. Founder of Genpact, he pioneered the Business Process Management industry. He has co-founded Clix Capital, Asha Ventures, and the Punjab…
f: Pramod Bhasin is Chairman of ICRIER and the Data Security Council of India. Founder of Genpact, he pioneered the Business Process Management industry. He has co-founded Clix Capital, Asha Ventures, and the Punjab Innovation Mission and played a key role in Plaksha and Ashoka Universities. He also leads Aparajita , an NGO focused on sexual harassment.

b: Pramod Kapoor , the founder and publisher of Roli Books, has over the course of his illustrious career, conceived and produced award-winning books that have proven to be game-changers in the world of publishing. In…
f: Pramod Kapoor , the founder and publisher of Roli Books, has over the course of his illustrious career, conceived and produced award-winning books that have proven to be game-changers in the world of publishing. In 2016, he authored the internationally acclaimed Gandhi: An Illustrated Biography, published in eleven editions in most major languages worldwide. He was conferred with the prestigious Chevalier de la Legion d’Honneur for his contribution towards producing books that have changed the landscape of Indian publishing. He is also a recipient of the Mahatma Award 2021 (an Aditya Birla Group initiative) for Lifetime Achievement for his work in publishing and literature.

b: Pramod Kumar K.G. is the Managing Director of Eka Archiving Services. He was the founder director of the Anokhi Museum of Hand Printing and was the first director of the Jaipur Literature Festival in 2006. He currently…
f: Pramod Kumar K.G. is the Managing Director of Eka Archiving Services. He was the founder director of the Anokhi Museum of Hand Printing and was the first director of the Jaipur Literature Festival in 2006. He currently co-directs the Mountain Echoes literary festival and has authored and edited several publications including Long Exposure The Camera at Udaipur, 1857-1957 and Posing for Posterity: Royal Indian Portraits .

b: Pramod Shah “Nafees”, a practising Chartered Accountant for over forty years, based in Kolkata, has authored nearly two hundred articles, poetry and columns for various magazines & journals of national repute, and…
f: Pramod Shah “Nafees”, a practising Chartered Accountant for over forty years, based in Kolkata, has authored nearly two hundred articles, poetry and columns for various magazines & journals of national repute, and has written, compiled, interviewed and edited around eighteen books on topics such as Urdu-Hindi Poetry, Persian-Urdu Poets, Contemporary incidents, History, Management, Indian Philosophy & Thought etc.

b: Pranay Lal is a biochemist by training and works for a non-profit organisation on public health. His first book, Indica: A Deep Natural History of the Indian Subcontinent, won the best non-fiction debut award at the…
f: Pranay Lal is a biochemist by training and works for a non-profit organisation on public health. His first book, Indica: A Deep Natural History of the Indian Subcontinent, won the best non-fiction debut award at the Tata Lit Fest in Mumbai in 2017, the best book award at the Delhi Book Fair 2017, and was named among the top 10 memorable books of the year by Amazon and The Hindu's non-fiction list of 2017. He is currently writing a book on the natural history of viruses, which is due for release in summer 2021.

b: Pranika Sharma is a literary dynamo with a master’s degree in creative writing from Loughborough University, UK. Her career began with freelance editing and stints at The Afternoon Dispatch & Courier, eventually leading…
f: Pranika Sharma is a literary dynamo with a master’s degree in creative writing from Loughborough University, UK. Her career began with freelance editing and stints at The Afternoon Dispatch & Courier, eventually leading to roles at Penguin Random House and Harper Collins, where she refined her editorial expertise and gained invaluable insights into the craft of storytelling.

b: Prasenjit K. Basu is the author of Asia Reborn , which won the Tata Literature First Book Award (non-fiction) for 2018. He has written for T he New York Times, Financial Times, India Today, Economic Times, Business…
f: Prasenjit K. Basu is the author of Asia Reborn , which won the Tata Literature First Book Award (non-fiction) for 2018. He has written for T he New York Times, Financial Times, India Today, Economic Times, Business Times (Singapore), New Straits Times, The Statesman and Swarajya , and commented on Asia’s economies on the BBC, CNBC, CNN, Channel News Asia and NDTV-Profit. Basu was Chief Economist for SEAsia & India at Credit Suisse, Chief Asia Economist at Daiwa Securities, Chief Economist at Malaysia’s Khazanah Nasional and has held senior research roles at Maybank, Macquarie and UBS. He has taught at the University of Pennsylvania, ESSEC Asia Pacific and SP Jain School of Global Management (Singapore and Dubai).

b: Prasoon Joshi is an acclaimed poet, screen and songwriter. Feted at international shows like Cannes he has also been awarded the Padma Shri and several National Awards. The author of four books of poetry, the first one…
f: Prasoon Joshi is an acclaimed poet, screen and songwriter. Feted at international shows like Cannes he has also been awarded the Padma Shri and several National Awards. The author of four books of poetry, the first one at the age of 17, a screenplay and songwriter of award-winning feature films like T aare Zameen Par, Bhaag Milkha Bhaag, Rang De Basanti, Neerja, Manikarnika and many more. Creator of aocially relevant communication such as that of women empowerment, child rights, pulse polio, Swachh Bharat, nutrition, he has wielded his pen for many a relevant cause. Joshi is one of those rare creative voices who bridge many divides, high and popular culture, Hindi and English, commercial cinema and urbane poetry, advertising and art. Known to have the pulse of India and a way into its heart, he is one of the most evocative chroniclers of our times.

b: Prathyusha Agarwal is the Chief Marketing Officer at Zee Entertainment Enterprises Limited (ZEEL), driving viewer led brand and business growth for the company. She has been a part of the ZEEL family since January 2017…
f: Prathyusha Agarwal is the Chief Marketing Officer at Zee Entertainment Enterprises Limited (ZEEL), driving viewer led brand and business growth for the company. She has been a part of the ZEEL family since January 2017 and leads the marketing function for the Domestic Broadcast business while spearheading key strategic initiatives and driving marketing capabilities across the company. At ZEE, she spearheads business transformation initiatives and the brand growth mandate, which have resulted in increased network share for India’s leading media and entertainment powerhouse. Under her leadership, ZEE has received several accolades including being recognized as the only Indian Content brand to be felicitated at the prestigious World Branding Forum (WBF), bagging the Marketing Team of the Year award at the Indian Marketing Awards, and being felicitated with a silver for its campaign ‘The Great Indian Middle Class Awakening’ on Zee TV in the Corporate Advertising Category at the Effies 2019, amongst many others.

b: Pratinav Anil is a Lecturer in History at the University of Oxford. He is the author of two bleak histories, India's First Dictatorship and Another India. More recently he has, perhaps unwarrantedly, acquired a…
f: Pratinav Anil is a Lecturer in History at the University of Oxford. He is the author of two bleak histories, India's First Dictatorship and Another India. More recently he has, perhaps unwarrantedly, acquired a reputation as a stern reviewer for the Times .

b: Pratishtha Singh is the National Coordinator for Working Women for the Congress Party. Dr. Singh has been a lecturer of Italian literature in DU and is an expert of WWII and Mussolini. She has worked extensively in…
f: Pratishtha Singh is the National Coordinator for Working Women for the Congress Party. Dr. Singh has been a lecturer of Italian literature in DU and is an expert of WWII and Mussolini. She has worked extensively in Rajasthan and with women with the Rajiv Gandhi Foundation. In 2014, she managed the media and the women campaign for Mohammad Azharuddin from Sawai Madhopur. In 2015, she traveled alone across Bihar during the assembly elections to talk to female voters. Her travel experiences and conversations have recently been published in the form of a Hindi and Bhojpuri book by Vani Prakashan.

b: Praveen Swami is a contributing editor at ThePrint, and writes on regional security issues. He has earlier worked as National Security Editor of The Indian Express , Resident Editor of The Hindu in New Delhi, and as…
f: Praveen Swami is a contributing editor at ThePrint, and writes on regional security issues. He has earlier worked as National Security Editor of The Indian Express , Resident Editor of The Hindu in New Delhi, and as Diplomatic Editor of The Daily Telegraph in London. He is the author of India, Pakistan and the Secret Jihad: the Covert War in Jammu and Kashmir , as well as several edited volumes and academic papers.

b: Pravin Kumar is an assistant professor of Hindi in the University of Delhi. Apart from his passion in teaching, Dr. Kumar’s creative talents are well appreciated by many as a prolific author of interesting stories.…
f: Pravin Kumar is an assistant professor of Hindi in the University of Delhi. Apart from his passion in teaching, Dr. Kumar’s creative talents are well appreciated by many as a prolific author of interesting stories. Being a storyteller, he has been awarded and continuously recognised by the various institutions of eminence.

b: Prayaag Akbar is the author of the novels Mother India (2024) and Leila (2017), which won the Crossword Jury Prize and the Tata Literature First Book Award. The novel was translated into Hindi, Marathi and Turkish, and…
f: Prayaag Akbar is the author of the novels Mother India (2024) and Leila (2017), which won the Crossword Jury Prize and the Tata Literature First Book Award. The novel was translated into Hindi, Marathi and Turkish, and was the basis of a popular Netflix series.

b: Preeti Vyas is the President and CEO of Amar Chitra Katha Private Limited, publishers of the iconic Amar Chitra Katha comics and Tinkle magazine . She is also the Founder of FunOKPlease Children's Publishing. Through…
f: Preeti Vyas is the President and CEO of Amar Chitra Katha Private Limited, publishers of the iconic Amar Chitra Katha comics and Tinkle magazine . She is also the Founder of FunOKPlease Children's Publishing. Through her 27-year-long career, she has been a book retailer, marketer, publisher, editor, author and entrepreneur. Vyas believes passionately in the power of children’s books to shape the future of India and the world.

b: Prem Jha is a former editor of the Economic Times and the Hindustan Times, who has written on the economy and the environment for the past five decades. He was a member of the energy panel of the World Commission on…
f: Prem Jha is a former editor of the Economic Times and the Hindustan Times, who has written on the economy and the environment for the past five decades. He was a member of the energy panel of the World Commission on Environment and Development. He is the author of Dawn of the Solar Age: An End to Global Warming, and to Fear . He is currently a Visiting Fellow at the School For Engineering and Applied Sciences at Harvard University and co-authoring a book on India's transition out of fossil fuels by 2060.

b: Prem K. Krishnan , an educationist and former principal of Delhi Public School, writes stories lined with the pain and joys of being women, the search for individuality and the constantly struggle against gender…
f: Prem K. Krishnan , an educationist and former principal of Delhi Public School, writes stories lined with the pain and joys of being women, the search for individuality and the constantly struggle against gender discrimination. Krishnan has been instrumental in setting up a number of schools in U.P. and West Bengal. Her keen interest in the arts, theatre and literature has inspired her to direct and produce a number of productions including Girish Karnad’s Tughlaq , Oscar Wilde’s and The Importance of Being Earnest , amongst others. She currently devotes her energies to the Lioness Club and takes a keen and passionate interest in politics and her grandson.

b: Prem Panicker is a journalist and editor with 32 years of experience. He is one of the handful of journalists who helped launch Rediff.com, India’s first internet-only news site and has been editor of the New…
f: Prem Panicker is a journalist and editor with 32 years of experience. He is one of the handful of journalists who helped launch Rediff.com, India’s first internet-only news site and has been editor of the New York-based India Abroad , the newsmagazine of record for the influential Indian American committee. He was managing editor of Yahoo India till November 2014, after which he helped found the independent site Peepli.org which focuses on multimedia long-form storytelling on issues relating to water, climate change, the environment, wildlife and man/animal conflict. He is currently consulting editor with IndiaSpend .

b: Prem Shankar Jha , born 22 December 1938, in Patna, Bihar, was raised in New Delhi and educated at The Doon School, Dehradun. He earned a Bachelor’s degree in economics from the University of Delhi and a Master of Arts…
f: Prem Shankar Jha , born 22 December 1938, in Patna, Bihar, was raised in New Delhi and educated at The Doon School, Dehradun. He earned a Bachelor’s degree in economics from the University of Delhi and a Master of Arts in philosophy, politics and economics at Magdalen College, Oxford. In 1961, he joined the United Nations where he spent five years in the United Nations Development Programme (UNDP). He spent two of these five years in New York as a special assistant to the managing director of the Special Fund, Paul G. Hoffman, who was the first administrator of the UNDP. The remaining three were spent in Damascus, Syria.

b: Premila Nazareth Satyanand has worked with the UN Centre on Transnational Corporations, the Economist Intelligence Unit and others, researching foreign investment and supporting policy dialogue on economic…
f: Premila Nazareth Satyanand has worked with the UN Centre on Transnational Corporations, the Economist Intelligence Unit and others, researching foreign investment and supporting policy dialogue on economic liberalization. She now spends much of her time in the rural Himalayas, contributing to grassroots health, education and livelihood initiatives that strengthen local communities.

b: Premjish Achari is a Delhi based curator, writer and filmmaker dedicated to an intellectually rigorous and politically informed engagement with contemporary art. He conceptualises exhibitions and discussions as acts of…
f: Premjish Achari is a Delhi based curator, writer and filmmaker dedicated to an intellectually rigorous and politically informed engagement with contemporary art. He conceptualises exhibitions and discussions as acts of philosophical reckoning, spaces where the architecture of encounter becomes a method for questioning knowledge production.

b: Prerana Shrimali , a Sangeet Natak Akademi awardee, is one of India’s leading Kathak dancers. Trained by Guru Shri Kundanlal Gangani of Jaipur Gharana, she is known for her unique solo performances. She has explored…
f: Prerana Shrimali , a Sangeet Natak Akademi awardee, is one of India’s leading Kathak dancers. Trained by Guru Shri Kundanlal Gangani of Jaipur Gharana, she is known for her unique solo performances. She has explored poetry by Kalidas, Meera, Kabir, Ghalib, and Yves Bonnefoy. In 2022, she published TATKAAR: Kathak ki Antaryatra .

b: Prerna Singh Bindra has been at the forefront of the battle to conserve India’s wildlife for over a decade. She was a member of India’s National Board for Wildlife. Her recently released books include The Vanishing:…
f: Prerna Singh Bindra has been at the forefront of the battle to conserve India’s wildlife for over a decade. She was a member of India’s National Board for Wildlife. Her recently released books include The Vanishing: India’s Wildlife Crisis and When I Grow up I Want to be a Tiger . See more at http://prernabindra.com

b: Preti Taneja's second book Aftermath won the Gordon Burn Prize 2022 for literature that is 'forward thinking and fearless in its ambition and execution, often playing with style, pushing boundaries, crossing genres or…
f: Preti Taneja's second book Aftermath won the Gordon Burn Prize 2022 for literature that is 'forward thinking and fearless in its ambition and execution, often playing with style, pushing boundaries, crossing genres or challenging readers' expectations.' It was a New Statesman and a New Yorker Book of the Year. Taneja is co-chair of English PEN’s Translation Advisory Group and professor of World Literature and Creative Writing at Newcastle University, UK.

b: Priya Atwal is a historian of empire, monarchy and cultural politics across Britain and South Asia. She has taught History at King's College London and Oxford where she obtained her doctorate. Her research has been…
f: Priya Atwal is a historian of empire, monarchy and cultural politics across Britain and South Asia. She has taught History at King's College London and Oxford where she obtained her doctorate. Her research has been featured in collaborative projects with Historic Royal Palaces, among others; and she makes regular broadcast appearances, most recently presenting the BBC Radio 4 series, Lies My Teacher Told Me. She tweets @priyaatwal.

b: Priya Malik is an award-winning poet, storyteller, and actor who writes in English, Hindi, and Urdu, exploring love and relationships. Her viral poem Main 2019 Main 1999 Dhoond Rahi Hoon brought her acclaim. Malik’s…
f: Priya Malik is an award-winning poet, storyteller, and actor who writes in English, Hindi, and Urdu, exploring love and relationships. Her viral poem Main 2019 Main 1999 Dhoond Rahi Hoon brought her acclaim. Malik’s solo show Ishq Hai has toured India, and her upcoming poetry collections, Ishq ke Saat Padaav and For Those Who Love Too Much , release this year.

b: Priya Sahgal is the Senior Executive Editor at NewsX, where she anchors two award-winning shows - ‘The Roundtable’ and ‘Cover Story’. She has been a journalist for nearly three decades working at India Today,…
f: Priya Sahgal is the Senior Executive Editor at NewsX, where she anchors two award-winning shows - ‘The Roundtable’ and ‘Cover Story’. She has been a journalist for nearly three decades working at India Today, The Outlook and Sunday magazines. Her forte is political journalism, and she has also written a book, The Contenders, that profiles 16 Gen Next political leaders of India from Rahul Gandhi, Akhilesh Yadav, Yogi Adityanath, Arvind Kejriwal to the Badals.

b: Priya Sarukkai Chabria is an award-winning poet, translator and writer known for her radical aesthetic. Her books include speculative fiction Clone , Generation 14 , translation Andal the Autobiography of a Goddess ,…
f: Priya Sarukkai Chabria is an award-winning poet, translator and writer known for her radical aesthetic. Her books include speculative fiction Clone , Generation 14 , translation Andal the Autobiography of a Goddess , poetry Fafnir’s Heart World Poetry in Translation (as editor), Not Springtime Yet, Dialogue and Other Poems and non-fiction Bombay/Mumbai: Immersions . She edits poetry at Sagam .

b: Priya Satia is the Raymond A. Spruance Professor of International History and Professor of History at Stanford University. Her latest book, Time’s Monster: History, Conscience and Britain’s Empire, was among the New…
f: Priya Satia is the Raymond A. Spruance Professor of International History and Professor of History at Stanford University. Her latest book, Time’s Monster: History, Conscience and Britain’s Empire, was among the New Statesman 's and BBC History Magazine 's Books of the Year . Prizes for her previous books, Empire of Guns and Spies in Arabia, include major awards from the American Historical Association. Her academic and popular writing has also appeared in the American Historical Review , Past & Present, Time, the Washington Post , TheWire.in, and elsewhere.

b: Priya Seth is a celebrated cinematographer with almost two decades of experience in Indian films. She has assisted on films like Deepa Mehta’s Earth and Jane Campion’s Holy Smoke . In 2003, she helmed her first…
f: Priya Seth is a celebrated cinematographer with almost two decades of experience in Indian films. She has assisted on films like Deepa Mehta’s Earth and Jane Campion’s Holy Smoke . She was the DoP on the 2017 feature Chef . She is also the leading underwater cinematographer in India for Hindi movies and commercials and is currently working on a historic series for the web. In her spare time, Seth helps run Ellora Studios, a highly successful multi set studio where many TV shows, films and ads are shot.

b: Priyam Gandhi-Mody is an author and political strategist. She has written three political non- fiction books, the latest being A Nation to Protect , which chronicles India’s pandemic handling from a top-down…
f: Priyam Gandhi-Mody is an author and political strategist. Gandhi-Mody has also been writing opinion pieces on the subject for Indian and international media, including The Telegraph, CNN-News18, The Epoch Times, The Economic Times, and Indian Express. She is currently working on her next book and as a creative producer on a movie, both are scheduled to be released in 2023.

b: Priyambada Jayakumar was raised in India, in the City of Joy—Kolkata. Born to a Bengali mother and a Tamil father, she completed her schooling at La Martiniere for Girls, Kolkata. She later moved to Delhi, where she…

She later moved to Delhi, where she earned a BA (Hons) in History from St. Stephen’s College, University of Delhi. This was followed by a Tripos in Social and Political Sciences from the University of Cambridge. Subsequently, she undertook further studies at Harvard University. She has lived in Delhi, London, and Boston, and is currently based in Singapore, where she lives with her husband and three children.

b: Priyamvada Natarajan , is a Professor of Astronomy and Physics at Yale University, and her research is focused on understanding the nature of exotica in the universe: dark matter, dark energy and black holes. She is…
f: Priyamvada Natarajan , is a Professor of Astronomy and Physics at Yale University, and her research is focused on understanding the nature of exotica in the universe: dark matter, dark energy and black holes. She is also the author of Mapping the Heavens: The Radical Scientific Ideas That Reveal The Cosmos. Priyamvada Natarajan , an astrophysicist and Professor at Yale, has made seminal contributions to our current understanding of the formation and growth of black holes, the origin of the first black holes and of the nature of dark matter by mapping it using gravitational lensing. A recipient of many awards and honours, she is also the author of the critically acclaimed Mapping the Heavens: The Radical Scientific Ideas that Reveal the Cosmos .

f: Priyank Narayan is the Founding Director of the Centre for Entrepreneurship at Ashoka University. He is also a guest faculty at IIT Delhi, IIM Ahmedabad and HEC Paris. She was featured on the cover of TIME magazine's coveted TIME 100 issue, named as one of the ‘Most Influential People’ in the world, and recognised as one of Forbes's Most Powerful Women. Chopra Jonas is a global UNICEF Goodwill Ambassador and received the prestigious Danny Kaye Humanitarian award. She is also involved in a number of efforts to protect children's rights and to promote the education of girls around the world, including her namesake charity, The Priyanka Chopra Foundation for Health and Education.

She is currently working on her second novel and contributes to The World of Interiors and The Nod Magazine . Khanna also writes and speaks on art, design, fashion, and parenting.

b: Priyanka Malhotra is young entrepreneur heading Full Circle Publishing and the Full Circle Bookstores. An alumnus of the London College of Printing and the London School of Economics, she has gained knowledge and…
f: Priyanka Malhotra is young entrepreneur heading Full Circle Publishing and the Full Circle Bookstores. Her latest project is bringing children’s content to readers in India and globally through Full Circle’s children’s imprint, Tota Books.

f: Priyanka Mattoo is the author of the memoir Bird Milk & Mosquito Bones (Knopf/Penguin India, June 2024). She contributes to The New Yorker and The New York Times and is a filmmaker, living in Los Angeles with her family.

f: Priyanka R. Khanna is an art, design and fashion writer, author and editor based in Mumbai, India. She has worked in the public relations department at Hearst Magazines in New York on publications including O, The Oprah Magazine, Harper’s Bazaar, CosmoGirl! and Seventeen. She returned to Mumbai and joined the launch team of Vogue India, where she spent 15 years, as the Fashion Features Director, overseeing fashion related content across digital and print. Khanna has interviewed and profiled designers such as Karl Lagerfeld, Ralph Lauren, Haider Ackermann, Peter Dundas, Isabel Marant, Sabyasachi and Tarun Tahiliani to name a few; artists like Pharell Williams; actors like Salma Hayek, Marion Cotillard, Mila Kunis, Twinkle Khanna, Alia Bhatt, Deepika Padukone, Sonam Kapoor Ahuja, Kareena Kapoor Khan and many more. She is currently a contributing editor at The World Of Interiors and an advisor at Share A Book India.

f: Pullela Gopichand is a badminton player who won five national championships between 1996 and 2000. During this period, he also won two Gold medals at the national games of 1998. His international career kickstarted in 1991 when he was chosen to represent the Indian team against Malaysia. He made big strides at the highest level after winning two Gold medals at the SAARC Badminton Championship. He also later went on to win medals at the Commonwealth Games in 1998 and won a variety of other tournaments like Toulouze Open, Scottish Open and the Asian Satellite Open. His crowning glory came in 2001 when he became just the second Indian after Prakash Padukone to win the prestigious All England Championships. The famous All England championship win came at a small cost as Gopi was blighted by injuries. This is when he decided to take up coaching, open a world class training facility and impart his experience to young players.

f: Punam Chadha-Joseph , an ex-advertising and hospitality professional has received much acclaim for her first book of poems The Soulful Seeker . Chadha-Joseph’s interest in sketching continues and she hopes to incorporate her new sketches in her new books too.

b: Puneeta Roy is a core team member of the Karmic Research Center, a space that focuses on the wellbeing of an individual, from a holistic point of view. Set up in 2000, the activities at KRC empower the individual in the…
f: Puneeta Roy is a core team member of the Karmic Research Center, a space that focuses on the wellbeing of an individual, from a holistic point of view. Set up in 2000, the activities at KRC empower the individual in the use of a range of tools from meditation, theatre, role playing, martial arts, creative writing amongst others. A media professional with over 30 years of experience, her interest in expressive arts has led her to conduct workshops with young people using theatre and the arts as tools for self-exploration and transformation. As the Founder Trustee of The Yuva Ekta Foundation, her vision of equity and social justice has translated into the creation of several such platforms. The past decade has ignited a deep interest in emotional intelligence especially in the labyrinth of human relationships, even as the exploration of one’s own self moves towards greater awareness and compassion. She sees tremendous potential in the youth of today and believes that through them positive social change will happen. Her vision is directed towards building a more equitable society, one in which under- privileged youth can dialogue with their more fortunate peers and learn from each other. She dreams of setting up a Global Youth Citizenship Network, one that would unite like minded young people from across the world and together create a more loving, sustainable planet.

b: Purushottam Agrawal , a former JNU professor and British Academy fellow at Wolfson College, University of Cambridge, served as a member of UPSC of India. He is a celebrated scholar of Kabir and Bhakti sensibility, and…
f: Purushottam Agrawal , a former JNU professor and British Academy fellow at Wolfson College, University of Cambridge, served as a member of UPSC of India. He is a celebrated scholar of Kabir and Bhakti sensibility, and also of Nehru. His latest work Kabir, Kabir: The Life and Work of An Early Modern Poet-Philosopher , is a best-seller. Agrawal’s Who is Bharat Mata? is an anthology of Nehru’s reflections on the idea of India with a thought-provoking introduction that takes the reader on a breath-taking journey into Nehru’s mind and dismantles many frameworks of debate around Nehru.

f: Purushottam Agrawal is a literary historian and fiction writer. His works include pathbreaking studies like Akath Kahani Prem Ki: Kabir ki Kavita aur Un ka Samay, Kabir, Kabir: The Life and work of Early Modern Poet Philosopher, Padmavat: An Epic Love Story, and Who is Bharat Mata , an exploration of Nehru’s ideas about India, its tradition, culture and history. Besides some short stories, he has to his credit a Hindi novel called NACOHUS , a Kafkaesque fantasy about politics of hurt sentiments, which is soon to appear in English translation. He is a British Academy Fellow at Wolfson College, University of Cambridge, and has served as professor at the Jawaharlal Nehru University, and as member of the Union Public Service Commission, India.

Pant has also gained acclaim as a columnist and television host, bringing India's gastronomic legacy to global audiences.

b: Quasar Thakore Padamsee is a theatre-holic. Since 1999, he has directed and produced over 25 plays with Bombay based QTP, including E very Brilliant Thing, A Peasant of El Salvador, Project S.T.R.I.P., So Many Socks,…
f: Quasar Thakore Padamsee is a theatre-holic. f: R. Balakrishnan is a researcher, author, poet, and former IAS officer of the Odisha cadre, with over 35 years of research on the Indus Civilization and Dravidian studies. His research articles on Odisha and its culture have been translated into Odia. He currently heads the International Institute of Tamil Studies and serves as Honorary Consultant at the Indus Research Centre, Roja Muthiah Research Library.

b: H.H. Maharani Radhikaraje Gaekwad is Vice President, Maharani Chimnabai Stree Udyogalaya, Trustee, Maharaja Fatesingh Museum, Director, CDS Art Foundation, and an Aspen Global Leadership Network Fellow. She holds an…

He later served as Minister of Defence (2005–2007), Foreign Affairs (2007–2014), and Speaker of the Sejm (2014–2015). Between 2019 and 2023 he was a Member of the European Parliament, chaired the U.S. relations delegation, and sat on key foreign-affairs and security subcommittees. He has authored several books and is married to journalist-writer Anne Applebaum; together they have two sons.

f: Rahaab Allana is the Curator/Publisher of Alkazi Foundation for the Arts, New Delhi. f: Rakesh Mohan is a distinguished economist and veteran policy maker who currently serves as the President Emeritus of CSEP, New Delhi.
